from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any

from models import Customer


def map_customer_response_to_customer(source: dict[str, Any]) -> Customer:
    return Customer(
        customer_id=source["customer_id"],
        first_name=source["given_name"],
        last_name=source["surname"],
        email=source["mail"],
        birth_date=date.fromisoformat(source["dob"]),
        phone=source["tel"],
        order_quantity=source["qty_orders"],
        created_at=datetime.fromisoformat(source["creation_date"]),
    )

from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any


def map_customer_response_to_customer(source: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "customerId": source["customer_id"],
        "firstName": source["given_name"],
        "lastName": source["surname"],
        "email": source["mail"],
        "birthDate": date.fromisoformat(source["dob"]),
        "phone": source["tel"],
        "orderQuantity": source["qty_orders"],
        "createdAt": datetime.fromisoformat(source["creation_date"]),
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class CustomerResponseMapper
{
    public static function toCustomer(array $source): Customer
    {
        return new Customer(
            customerId: $source['customer_id'],
            firstName: $source['given_name'],
            lastName: $source['surname'],
            email: $source['mail'],
            birthDate: new \DateTimeImmutable($source['dob']),
            phone: $source['tel'],
            orderQuantity: $source['qty_orders'],
            createdAt: new \DateTimeImmutable($source['creation_date']),
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class CustomerResponseMapper
{
    public static function toCustomer(array $source): array
    {
        return [
            'customerId' => $source['customer_id'],
            'firstName' => $source['given_name'],
            'lastName' => $source['surname'],
            'email' => $source['mail'],
            'birthDate' => new \DateTimeImmutable($source['dob']),
            'phone' => $source['tel'],
            'orderQuantity' => $source['qty_orders'],
            'createdAt' => new \DateTimeImmutable($source['creation_date']),
        ];
    }
}
